items.title: Calendar dates don't match their weekdays
items.detail: The matrix labels Nov 18, 2026 as a Monday, but it is a Wednesday. Every date is two days ahead of its weekday label.
items.recommendation: Pick the real Monday Week 1 starts on, then re-date all four weeks.

items.title: 8-week upload gap, then a plan for 7 posts a week
items.detail: Nothing was published between Sep 13 and Nov 9. The calendar assumes 3 Shorts, 1 long video, a Skool post, a live and a digest every week.
items.recommendation: Commit to 1 long video + 2 Shorts a week for 6 straight weeks before adding lives and masterclasses.

items.title: Targets are far above your baseline
items.detail: The plan targets 150,000 views in 90 days. All 38 videos together have 7,015. Long-form averages 207 views and Shorts 99.
items.recommendation: Rewrite the OKR targets from your real averages and drop the percentage probabilities.

items.title: Tool how-to Shorts beat mindset Shorts about 8x
items.detail: The two Kilo Shorts got 193 and 179 views. The mindset and concept Shorts got 20 to 51.
items.recommendation: Make Shorts concrete tool demos (Kilo, Claude Code, n8n) and use the Delivery Pilot framing as the thread, not the hook.

items.title: Watch hours and subscriber trend are missing
items.detail: The YPP plan needs 4,000 watch hours and 1,000 subscribers. Neither figure is in the repo, and 725 subscribers is hand-entered.
items.recommendation: Export the 365-day channel and per-video CSVs from YouTube Studio into data/studio/.

items.title: Key Vault token expired for the cloud session
items.detail: The vault answers, but the injected Azure token returned TokenExpired, so vault contents and the managed-identity setup are unverified.
items.recommendation: Refresh the Key Vault connection, then check each Key Vault reference shows Resolved in the Function App.

items.title: YouTube is blocked from the cloud session
items.detail: Requests to www.youtube.com return 403, so the dashboard numbers are the Nov 17 snapshot.
items.recommendation: Add www.youtube.com, www.googleapis.com and youtubeanalytics.googleapis.com to the environment's network allowlist.

items.title: Masterclass length conflicts with the 3x5 min format
items.detail: The calendar schedules 45 to 60 minute masterclasses. The README and production plan call for 3 videos of 5 minutes and a 10.5 hr/week cap.
items.recommendation: Pick one. If the 3x5 format stays, split each masterclass into modules.

items.title: Read the realistic expectations before you plan Week 1
items.detail: The likely 90-day outcome is about 6,000 to 10,000 views, against the plan's 150,000. 1,000 subscribers is more likely spring or summer 2027 than Jan to Feb.
items.recommendation: Judge yourself on publishing consistency for the first 6 weeks, not on views.
